name: JANUS_DUAL_DEBT_CERTIFIED_LIFECYCLE_KERNEL
purpose: Unify exact witness-reconstruction obligations with exact deferred-operation obligations, while preserving representation capabilities, charged work, liabilities, provenance and receipts across representation changes and semantic roundtrips.

design_boundary.semantic_debt_question: Which original witness obligations have been projected away but do not yet have accepted reconstruction authority?
design_boundary.transformation_debt_question: Which exact requested operations have been deferred or rerouted but do not yet have an accepted execution/subsumption certificate?
design_boundary.orthogonal_liabilities: Discovery work, verification work, representation materialization cost and future upper-bound liabilities are recorded, but are not themselves promoted to a third debt class in v1.0.
design_boundary.reason_for_two_class_v1: Keep the first conservation theorem mathematically clean. Certification/discovery debt can be added later only if it cannot be represented as proof/liability metadata on semantic or transformation obligations.

components.S_sem: The strengthened Projected Semantic Debt Kernel state, including F0_id,R,Z,D,V_live,V_debt,V_cert,Omega,Pi,q,rho.
components.Cap: Verified capability profile for L: exact supported operations, status POLY_CERTIFIED/FINITE_CERTIFIED/UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED, and translation/verification contracts.
components.Q_issued: Immutable set of transformation obligation identifiers that have been issued so far.
components.Q_debt: Issued exact operation obligations not yet certified complete or certified superseded.
components.Q_cert: Issued exact operation obligations closed by an accepted execution or exact supersession receipt.
components.C_charged: Monotone accumulated charged producer/discovery/materialization/translation/verification work already paid by the lifecycle.
components.Lambda: Outstanding resource/verification liabilities with explicit upper-bound status. UNKNOWN may exist but blocks polynomial promotion.
components.Prov: Immutable provenance and historical identity, including every representation switch and operation attempt.
components.Receipts: Content-addressed transition, execution, switch, refusal, and discharge receipts.
components.VaultRefs: Capability-scoped exact OPEN-vault references. They are search memory only, never SAT/UNSAT authority.

transformation_obligation.issue_rule: Every exact operation that becomes required by the current solver plan receives a fresh immutable req_id and is inserted into Q_issued and Q_debt unless it is executed and certified atomically at issuance.
transformation_obligation.execution_discharge: EXECUTED_CERTIFIED requires an accepted receipt proving that the requested exact operation was carried out with the required output semantics and verifier contract.
transformation_obligation.supersession_discharge: SUPERSEDED_CERTIFIED requires an accepted exact proof that a later certified result makes the requested operation unnecessary while preserving the original terminal contract. Scheduler preference or abandonment is not sufficient.
forbidden: Deleting an obligation because a different representation was chosen.
Deleting an obligation because the current IR is syntactically small.
Deleting an obligation because the route is UNKNOWN or expensive.
Resetting obligation status after an A->B->A semantic roundtrip.

capability_passport.meaning: Exact represented relation/domain and source binding.
capability_passport.representation: Current exact carrier/language plus content identity.
capability_passport.capabilities: Operation map and certified translation/execution routes.
capability_passport.costs: Already charged historical work; never reset by representation identity.
capability_passport.semantic_debt: Projected original witness obligations not yet reconstructed/certified.
capability_passport.transformation_debt: Issued exact operations not yet executed or exactly superseded.
capability_passport.liabilities: Future verified/upper-bound obligations and UNKNOWN barriers.
capability_passport.provenance: Immutable historical route, including failed candidate attempts when they are charged.
capability_passport.receipts: Independent evidence for every authority-bearing transition.

legal_transitions.SEMANTIC_TRANSITIONS: All strengthened Projected Semantic Debt Kernel transitions remain legal only under their existing independent verifiers.

ISSUE_OPERATION.effect: Create fresh req_id; add it to Q_issued and Q_debt, or atomically to Q_issued and Q_cert if executed and certified in the same transaction.
ISSUE_OPERATION.progress: No semantic progress. Issuing a required operation may increase transformation burden.
ISSUE_OPERATION.authority: Operation identity and required output contract must be explicit.

DEFER_OPERATION.precondition: Operation is issued but not currently executed under a certified route.
DEFER_OPERATION.effect: Keep req_id in Q_debt; optionally attach route/capability metadata and liability upper bounds.
DEFER_OPERATION.progress: Zero certified progress of either debt class.

EXECUTE_CERTIFIED.precondition: Exact operation output and its verification receipt satisfy the obligation contract.
EXECUTE_CERTIFIED.effect: Move req_id from Q_debt to Q_cert with status EXECUTED_CERTIFIED; charge all required work and preserve receipt ancestry.
EXECUTE_CERTIFIED.progress: Transformation closure increases by one obligation; semantic progress changes only if a separate semantic DISCHARGE is also certified.

SUPERSEDE_CERTIFIED.precondition: An exact proof shows that the terminal/source contract no longer requires this operation because another already-certified result subsumes its required output semantics.
SUPERSEDE_CERTIFIED.effect: Move req_id from Q_debt to Q_cert with status SUPERSEDED_CERTIFIED.
SUPERSEDE_CERTIFIED.forbidden: No supersession from scheduler choice, timeout, OPEN, lack of interest, or unverified equivalence.

SWITCH_REPRESENTATION.precondition: Exact meaning-preserving translation/isomorphism receipt plus destination capability passport; any translation/materialization/verification work is charged.
SWITCH_REPRESENTATION.effect: L and Cap may change. S_sem remains semantically exact. Q_issued, Q_debt, and Q_cert retain obligation identities and statuses unless the switch is an explicitly atomic switch+execute macro with its own discharge receipt.
SWITCH_REPRESENTATION.zero_credit_rule: Switching representation alone gives zero semantic progress and zero transformation-debt discharge.
SWITCH_REPRESENTATION.liability_rule: Known/UNKNOWN future liabilities are transferred; they are not erased by the switch.

ATOMIC_SWITCH_AND_EXECUTE.precondition: The transition includes both an exact representation switch and an accepted execution receipt for named transformation obligations.
ATOMIC_SWITCH_AND_EXECUTE.effect: Only the named and verified obligations move Q_debt->Q_cert. All switch cost/liability remains historically charged.
ATOMIC_SWITCH_AND_EXECUTE.purpose: Allow efficient escape routes without giving free credit to representation changes.

ATOMIC_EXTEND_AND_DISCHARGE.precondition: Auxiliary definitions are introduced and immediately consumed inside one exact macro that either certifies specified semantic debt or executes specified transformation obligations. Every auxiliary definition and elimination/reconstruction step is verified.
ATOMIC_EXTEND_AND_DISCHARGE.effect: Fresh extension variables receive zero progress credit by themselves. Only the certified discharge part changes V_cert or Q_cert.
ATOMIC_EXTEND_AND_DISCHARGE.forbidden: Speculative extension accumulation presented as progress.

OPEN_VAULT_LOOKUP.precondition: Exact canonical core digest, exact current capability digest, verified payloads and independent refusal replay.
OPEN_VAULT_LOOKUP.effect: May return a search-policy hint CACHED_OPEN_EXACT under this capability. It changes no semantic or transformation obligation status.
OPEN_VAULT_LOOKUP.staleness: Any capability change makes the old OPEN logically stale for the new capability while preserving history.
OPEN_VAULT_LOOKUP.authority: OPEN is portfolio/capability-scoped refusal memory, not intrinsic hardness and not SAT/UNSAT authority.

ROUNDTRIP.definition: A sequence of accepted exact switches/transformations that returns to a semantically/canonically identical representation state.
ROUNDTRIP.effect: Returning to an earlier semantic/representation hash does not reset Q_debt, semantic debt, C_charged, Lambda, provenance or receipts.

accounting_invariants.semantic_partition: X = V_live dot_union V_debt dot_union V_cert, inherited from the strengthened semantic kernel.
accounting_invariants.charged_history: C_charged is monotone nondecreasing; a roundtrip may add cost but cannot subtract already-paid cost.
accounting_invariants.liability_nonforgetfulness: A liability may be discharged/reduced only by a named accepted repayment/certificate transition; representation identity alone cannot remove it.

theorem_candidates.DD1_SEMANTIC_CONSERVATION: All accepted dual-debt transitions preserve the semantic obligation partition and the prior T1-T5 soundness hypotheses.
theorem_candidates.DD2_TRANSFORMATION_CONSERVATION: For every accepted state, Q_issued=Q_debt dot_union Q_cert. Issued operation obligations cannot disappear.
theorem_candidates.DD3_SWITCH_ZERO_DISCHARGE: A pure meaning-preserving representation switch leaves P_sem and P_trans unchanged and preserves all outstanding obligation identities.
theorem_candidates.DD4_NONFORGETFUL_ROUNDTRIP: Any accepted semantic/representation roundtrip preserves unresolved debt status and cannot decrease C_charged except that separately certified liabilities may be discharged by explicit receipts during the route.
theorem_candidates.DD5_DUAL_DEBT_TERMINAL_SOUNDNESS: If an accepted terminal satisfies semantic terminal conditions, Q_debt is empty for all terminal-required operation obligations, and all exact result/source replay conditions hold, then the terminal retains the prior conditional Skolem/source-soundness guarantee and contains no unaccounted deferred operation required by its own terminal contract.

open_interface: all semantic receipts closed and well-founded
exact D and composed f_X with prior T5 proof
Q_debt contains no operation obligation declared required for producing/verifying the terminal package
all Q_cert closures have execution or exact supersession receipts
UNKNOWN liabilities forbid any polynomial-complexity promotion but do not by themselves falsify semantic soundness
terminal_contract.closed_sat: Prior source replay is still mandatory. Transformation closure cannot substitute for semantic replay.
terminal_contract.closed_unsat: Prior exact false-domain/UNSAT certificate remains mandatory. OPEN/refusal memory cannot become UNSAT authority.

known: Knowledge compilation maps languages by succinctness and supported operations.
SAT preprocessing and projected compilation maintain reconstruction information.
Amortized analysis accounts for deferred/future work.
Proof systems distinguish certificate size from discovery/automatability.
Caches and theorem provers version/invalidate stored results.
nearest_prior_art_boundary.distinctive_candidate: The combined proof-state contract that simultaneously enforces semantic reconstruction conservation, operation-obligation conservation, capability-scoped representation switching, nonforgetful charged history, exact OPEN refusal memory and independent proof authority.

deliberate_nonclaims: Every transformation obligation can be discharged efficiently.
A cheap representation route always exists.
The scheduler can find the best route.
The lifecycle is polynomial on arbitrary SAT/BFS/QBF instances.
The combined architecture is historically novel or world-first.
